issues.description: extract_arch_from_url can return None, leading to a malformed URL with literal 'None'
issues.detail: If the arch regex doesn't match (e.g., unexpected URL format or a new arch), extract_arch_from_url returns None. The caller then builds 'latest/None/Packages/...' silently, producing a broken URL that may only fail at fetch time. The function should raise or the caller should check and error explicitly.

issues.description: nevra[0] uses first char of filename which may not match the package name's first letter
issues.detail: The Koji path layout is /Packages/<first-letter-of-package-name>/<nevra>. Using nevra[0] on the filename works for typical NVRAs but breaks if the filename starts with a non-letter (numeric, e.g. '389-ds-base-...') in the directory layout, or if naming conventions differ. Better to parse the package name from NEVRA and use its first letter.

issues.description: Race condition between commit merge and koji tagging is acknowledged but unmitigated
issues.detail: The PR description admits a race where Konflux may try to fetch a crafted coreos-pool URL before coreos-koji-tagger has tagged it. There is no retry, verification, or HEAD check in the code. At minimum, a comment in the source (not just the commit message) and ideally a verification step would help future maintainers and CI debugging.

issues.description: Hardcoded koji_url_base and arch list reduce flexibility
issues.detail: The base URL 'https://kojipkgs.fedoraproject.org/repos-dist/coreos-pool' and arch list ['x86_64','aarch64','ppc64le','s390x'] are hardcoded inside the helper. Consider module-level constants so they're discoverable and easier to update when a new arch (e.g., riscv64) is added.

issues.description: Substring match 'coreos-pool' in url is overly permissive
issues.detail: Using 'in url' to detect coreos-pool URLs would match any URL containing that substring anywhere (e.g., a path segment named similarly). Prefer url.startswith(koji_url_base) for a tighter check, consistent with the intent of the rewrite.

issues.description: No unit tests for the new URL rewriting logic
issues.detail: use_koji_url_only and extract_arch_from_url are pure functions ideal for unit testing, especially given edge cases (noarch packages, unusual NEVRAs, missing arch). Adding even a small test would guard against regressions and document expected behavior for each arch.

review.summary: The PR cleanly addresses the DNF5 baseurl bug by rewriting non-coreos-pool URLs into the canonical koji path. The main correctness risk is silent failure when extract_arch_from_url returns None — the resulting URL will contain literal 'None' and only fail at fetch time. The nevra[0] heuristic for the Packages subdirectory is fragile for non-letter-leading filenames. The acknowledged race with coreos-koji-tagger should be documented in code, and the logic deserves unit tests since it's pure and easy to cover.
